entries.title: A passed review holds when only main moved
entries.body: A careful task keeps its passed review when an update onto newer main does not edit the change. A change on main to the line right beside yours asks for a fresh review. A line moved beside the same neighbors still counts as the same change. The checks still have to pass.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new on screen: the review named on the task stays the one that passed, and the merge goes on.
